facts.site: Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop
facts.title: unplanned release of kinetic energy at P-9503

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 1 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control PARK_UP_AND_RESTRAINT: the parking, chocking and restraint of equipment was in place but did not perform, and the learning team review classified this as an organisational factor.
Control ZERO_ENERGY_VERIFICATION: the proving zero energy before intrusive work was never verified as effective, and the learning team review classified this as an organisational factor.

recommendations: Confirm at the next assurance activity that the parking, chocking and restraint of equipment on P-9503 and PT-9503 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in restoring plant to service, specifically handing back a partially completed isolation. P-9503 (dewatering pumps) is in service for pit dewatering. The task proceeded during transfer operations while the parking, chocking and restraint of equipment was in place but did not perform. The kinetic energy involved is held as rotating equipment, and the recorded presentation was entanglement, impact, crush.
response.summary: On 14 August 2023 a high potential incident was recorded on P-9503 and PT-9503 at Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop during transfer operations; kinetic energy held as rotating equipment was not released.
